sources.reviewed: Overview and all 19 listed candidate operations.
sources.findings: Ten selected tasks include Ethernet plug/coupler connection, a cable clip, protective cover and equipment controls. The nine excluded candidates include latched network disconnection, nut fastening, polarity-sensitive battery insertion and fault repair. Complete maintenance workflows are outside the reported benchmark scope.
sources.implication: Simple connector, battery and nut operations cannot claim novelty from object relabeling. A substantive workflow dependency might distinguish a task but still needs current board clearance.

sources.reviewed: Real-task catalog, simulation navigation catalog and Fasten Screws task details.
sources.findings: Fasten Screws uses three matching screw/nut pairs and checks alignment, rotational depth and gripper release, with partial credit by completed pairs.
sources.implication: Eight threaded nuts adds count to an established mechanism. Repetition alone remains inadequate; consider replacement or a distinct mechanically necessary assembly dependency.

sources.findings: The project targets knowledge transfer in lifelong robot learning.
sources.implication: Task-definition catalog has not been audited; no no-overlap claim is justified.

sources.reviewed: Project overview and current task-suite summary.
sources.findings: Kitchen-focused suite with 65 atomic tasks and 300 composite tasks. Atomic capabilities include insertion and opening/closing lids, and composite tasks sequence practical workflows.
sources.implication: A generic long sequence is not by itself a new capability. Individual task definitions still need comparison.

sources.reviewed: Project overview and displayed task examples.
sources.findings: Examples include drawer operations, placing household objects, stacking blocks and moving a can near fruit; the work studies simulation-to-real policy evaluation.
sources.implication: The visible examples do not establish a direct hardware-maintenance duplicate, but the full source task catalog remains unchecked.

sources.findings: Large collection of full household activities and long-horizon mobile manipulation; the dashboard lists 1016 task definitions across its scope.
sources.implication: Detailed definitions and synonyms must be searched before claiming absence of battery/device-service overlaps.
